1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

✅## v1.1 — Google Play release

Started 2026-11-08 while F-Droid waits (user decision). Play requires new personal accounts to run a closed test with at least 12 testers opted in continuously for 14 days before production access (Play Console help, checked 2026-11-08).

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.

 ## v1.1 — Google Play release

Started 2026-11-08 while F-Droid waits (user decision). Play requires new personal accounts to run a closed test with at least 12 testers opted in continuously for 14 days before production access (Play Console help, checked 2026-11-08).

1. Play developer account (user): one-time fee and identity verification.
2. Signing: Play App Signing with a separate upload key (kept out of git), or the existing release key — decide with the user.
3. Signed AAB build (`bundleRelease`), reproducible, no permissions.
4. Privacy policy page on GitHub Pages (no data collected) and the Data safety form.
5. Play store listing (reuse the fastlane text and images; check Play's limits).
6. Closed test: 12+ testers for 14 continuous days (user recruits testers).
7. Apply for production access and submit.
8. Accessibility audit.
9. Security review.
